just_in.title: Traditional Indian Diet and Daily Walks Put 60.9% of Early Diabetes Patients Into Remission
just_in.excerpt: A six-month programme of familiar Indian food in measured portions and 40 minutes of daily walking achieved remission in 53 of 87 adults with recent-onset type 2 diabetes — in a single-arm study its own authors say now needs a controlled trial.
just_in.image_caption: Members of the research team from Chellaram Diabetes Institute, Pune, and Dr Kale's Diabetes and Psychiatry Clinic, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, who ran the six-month dietary intervention study. The study reported remission in 60.9% of participants with early type 2 diabetes.

sources.label: PubMed — LHMC diet and structured exercise for diabetes remission in early type 2 diabetes (study abstract)

just_in.nri_angle: South Asians develop type 2 diabetes earlier and at lower body weights; a remission programme built on the food Indian families already eat — tested in Pune and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar — is directly relevant to diaspora readers managing early diabetes.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: US Measles Cases Jump by 426 in One Week to 5,838, the Largest Rise in Decades
just_in.excerpt: The CDC's latest tally is the first since the Pan American Health Organization declared measles endemic in the United States again, ending an elimination status held since 2000.
just_in.image_caption: A baby with measles in the Philippines, in a 2014 CDC Global photograph. Confirmed US measles cases rose by 426 in one week to 5,838 as of November 19, according to the CDC.
just_in.nri_angle: With 5,838 confirmed cases across 47 jurisdictions and kindergarten MMR coverage down to 92.4%, US-based Indian families should verify every household member's MMR record, especially before holiday travel.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Persistent Says Employee Immigration Data May Be Exfiltrated From US Law Firm
just_in.excerpt: The breach was at a US law firm handling Persistent's immigration matters, not the company's own systems, the Pune IT major told stock exchanges — without naming the firm or how many employees are affected.
just_in.image_caption: The Persistent Systems logo on a phone screen against a stock-market chart. The company told stock exchanges that employee immigration data may have been exfiltrated from a US law firm it engages, while its own systems remain secure.
just_in.nri_angle: Persistent employees with US immigration cases are the affected group; the filing names no action or deadline, so the next step to watch is direct notification to affected individuals.

immigration.title: House Bill Would Let Deportation Orders Expire After 10 Years and Open a Green Card Path
immigration.excerpt: The Protect Our Neighbors Act, introduced by four California Democrats, would put a 10-year expiry on final removal orders and let some longtime residents apply for permanent residence.

immigration.title: Persistent Says Employee Immigration Data May Be Exfiltrated From US Law Firm
immigration.excerpt: The breach was at a US law firm handling Persistent's immigration matters, not the company's own systems, the Pune IT major told stock exchanges — without naming the firm or how many employees are affected.
immigration.image_caption: The Persistent Systems logo on a phone screen against a stock-market chart. The company told stock exchanges that employee immigration data may have been exfiltrated from a US law firm it engages, while its own systems remain secure.
immigration.nri_angle: Persistent employees with US immigration cases are the affected group; the filing names no action or deadline, so the next step to watch is direct notification to affected individuals.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Texas State Employee Faces Losing His Job as DACA Renewal Stalls
immigration.excerpt: Juan Rodriguez filed to renew his DACA work permit in April. It is still pending, and the permit that supports his state job expires in December.
immigration.nri_angle: Renewal delays that outrun USCIS's own 120-day goal are the practical risk for work-authorized immigrants, including Indian-origin DACA holders and their employers.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Princeton PhD Student Eva Yi Xie Detained by ICE After Neuroscience Conference
immigration.excerpt: Her lawyers say a pending asylum claim lets her stay; ICE says she never had authorisation to study in the US. A federal judge has barred her removal from Virginia while her habeas petition is heard.
immigration.image_caption: A US Immigration and Customs Enforcement badge, in an Associated Press photograph. Princeton doctoral student Eva Yi Xie was detained by ICE at Reagan National Airport on November 19, 2026.
immigration.nri_angle: The detention happened on a domestic flight by a researcher with a pending asylum claim — a concrete reminder for international students and scholars in the US to verify their status with a lawyer before travelling, even inside the country.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Who Is Anupama Ramachandran? The Chennai Cueist Who Became the First Indian Woman to Win a World Snooker Title — and Just Defended It at Home
sports.excerpt: Born in Chennai in 2002, Anupama Ramachandran chose snooker over chess at a Mylapore Club summer camp at 13, won a world under-16 title at 15, and in November 2025 became the first Indian woman to win the IBSF World Snooker Championship — then defended it in Indore on November 21, 2026, to become the first Indian to win back-to-back world snooker crowns, all while completing two postgraduate degrees.
sports.image_caption: Anupama Ramachandran lines up a shot at the snooker table during competition. The Chennai player won her first IBSF world title in Doha in November 2025 and defended the crown in Indore in November 2026.
sports.nri_angle: The Chennai cueist who became the first Indian woman to win a world snooker title — and the first Indian to defend one — gives diaspora fans a new name at the top of a sport India had never conquered, and a visible path for girls who want to follow her to the table.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: UK Watchdog Warns AI Agents That Handle Money May Need Financial Authorisation
technology.excerpt: The FCA's November 24 guidance says what an agent does — not what its maker calls itself — decides whether financial regulation applies, and that regulated firms keep accountability even for third-party agents.
technology.nri_angle: Indian technology firms building AI agents for UK banks, insurers and fintechs are directly in scope: the FCA says activity, not a 'tech provider' label, decides whether authorisation is required.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: GalaxEye Awards Bellatrix Aerospace Propulsion Contract for Its Next 30 Satellites
technology.excerpt: The multi-year deal makes Bellatrix the primary propulsion supplier for GalaxEye's Drishti Gen-II imaging constellation — described by the two Bengaluru startups as India's largest private space order by satellite count.
technology.image_caption: GalaxEye and Bellatrix Aerospace executives display the signed agreement at the India International Space Conclave in New Delhi. Under the multi-year contract, Bellatrix will supply Arka propulsion systems for GalaxEye's next 30 Drishti Gen-II satellites.
technology.nri_angle: India's private space sector is maturing into a domestic supply chain, with startups now selling constellation-scale hardware to each other.

technology.title: Tech Mahindra Will Plough Margin Gains Into AI in Push to Be World-Beating by FY30
technology.excerpt: CEO Mohit Joshi tells businessline the turnaround ends in FY27, margins are close to 15 per cent, and the next phase is accelerated growth built on AI, talent and larger client relationships.
technology.image_caption: Mohit Joshi, CEO and Managing Director of Tech Mahindra. Joshi told businessline the company will reinvest its margin gains into AI as it targets becoming a world-beating IT services company by FY30.
technology.nri_angle: Tech Mahindra is one of the largest employers of Indian technology professionals worldwide; its AI hiring track and margin-funded growth plan shape opportunities across the diaspora tech workforce.

technology.nri_angle: For diaspora developers and businesses serving Indian-language users, Dictate offers a single API for dictation across English and 22 Indian languages at ₹0.50 a minute.

technology.title: Anthropic's Record $81.3 Billion IPO Opens 34% Higher, Then Fades to a 17% Gain

technology.nri_angle: For diaspora investors, the Tracxn figures show India's AI money concentrating in Mumbai and Bengaluru infrastructure deals, while India still takes just 0.4% of global AI funding.

technology.title: OpenAI's Chief Scientist Proposes Common AI Limits Measured by Perplexity

technology.image_caption: OpenAI signage photographed at a company event.
technology.nri_angle: A shared capability stop line would shape the models Indian-origin researchers and startups build on; for now it is a proposal with no threshold, date or signatories.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Microsoft's Brad Smith Defends Overseas Data Centres After Trump's Penalty Threat

technology.image_caption: Microsoft President Brad Smith in a portrait photograph. Smith told CBS Face the Nation that cloud data centres serving overseas customers must be located near those customers, after President Trump threatened penalties on companies building data centres abroad.
technology.nri_angle: Microsoft's $17.5 billion India build-out in Chennai, Hyderabad and Pune sits inside the policy debate, but neither side named India as a target and no change was announced.

technology.title: A Cancer Vaccine Made for One Patient? Hyderabad's RNA Foundry Is Building It

technology.nri_angle: A Hyderabad facility offering patient-specific cancer vaccines at a stated price is directly relevant to diaspora families who weigh treatment in India for relatives.

lifestyle-health.title: Traditional Indian Diet and Daily Walks Put 60.9% of Early Diabetes Patients Into Remission

carousel.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to Step Down After Decade at Helm
carousel.excerpt: Flipkart confirmed the Group CEO's exit on November 25. His last day is reported to be December 4, with a successor to be named in the coming weeks and the IPO still deferred.
carousel.image_caption: Flipkart headquarters and Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy, in an image published by Mint. Flipkart confirmed on November 25 that Krishnamurthy will step down, with a successor to be announced in the coming weeks.
carousel.nri_angle: Flipkart is the largest company in Walmart's India portfolio; its leadership change and deferred IPO shape one of the biggest consumer-internet businesses Indian investors and shoppers follow.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
